generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Form the hypothesis from opportunities, and form the mechanism to test the hypothesis.

contract.purpose_user_function: Current schemas can carry one hypothesis per idea candidate or experiment plan; a generated hypothesis pool and explicit mechanism model are not found.
contract.valid_inputs: Idea candidate hypothesis/approach, evidence IDs, research claims/methods, and experiment objective.
contract.expected_outputs: A single candidate/plan hypothesis plus approach/procedure; no verified multi-hypothesis pool or mechanism graph artifact.
contract.state_side_effects: Persists the chosen hypothesis in candidate and experiment-plan evidence.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing hypothesis prevents a valid experiment plan; no pool-level diversity, competing-mechanism, or selection failure behavior is implemented.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Single-hypothesis storage is supported. Alternative/competing hypotheses, mechanism nodes/edges, and pool ranking are absent.
contract.success_evidence: Partial: `harness/schemas/evidence/idea_candidate.v1.schema.json` and `experiment_plan.v1.schema.json` require/carry a hypothesis; no pool/mechanism schema was found.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Create tests for multiple hypotheses, null hypothesis, competing mechanisms, mechanism-to-observable link, evidence grounding, pool selection, and single-hypothesis fallback.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/ingest`, `/ideate`, `/exp-design`, `/exp-eval`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
